description: Synthetic read-only architecture review with referenced evidence.
scenario: Review the boundaries in the tiny synthetic session fixture. Identify one architecture risk and recommend a small, reversible next step.

result.summary: The fixture separates session parsing from page access, but its validation contract is not shared by both call sites.
risks: Callers may interpret malformed session values differently.
next_steps: Document the accepted session format and keep parsing behind one boundary.
